exposure: time from the first examination in the 20 hours before delivery
station recorded at the previous examination
outcome: Accuracy of labor curves in predicting cervical dilation and station
cohort: 8022 nulliparous women with a live, singleton, vertex-presenting fetus ≥35 weeks of gestation with a vaginal delivery
finding: Cervical dilation models based on multiple clinically relevant parameters demonstrated significantly improved accuracy compared to models based solely on time.
